hero.h1: Catch Basin Cleaning and Repair in Lincoln Park, Chicago
hero.sub: A gangway that floods, a back patio that holds water or a yard drain buried under leaves. We clean and repair catch basins and clear the lines they drain into. Our office is on Diversey Parkway.

img.alt: Cast iron catch basin grate at the edge of an asphalt driveway, partly covered with fallen leaves next to a landscaped garden bed

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: A catch basin is a small chamber under a grate that collects water from a yard, patio, gangway or downspout and sends it into a drain line. Debris settles in the bottom so it doesn't clog the pipe. In Chicago, many older yard basins are tied into the building's sewer, so a clogged basin can also affect the line.

img.alt: Diagram of a catch basin showing the inlet grate, water line, sediment settling in the sump and the outlet pipe carrying water away

blocks.h2: When a Lincoln Park Catch Basin Needs Service

tiles.body: Water pools between buildings and runs toward the basement.

blocks.h2: Catch Basins on Lincoln Park Lots
blocks.intro: Narrow lots and paved yards leave runoff few places to go.

items.body: Water between buildings heads straight for basement walls and stairwells.
Decades-old basins crack and lose mortar.
Many older basins drain to the building sewer, so a heavy storm can back them up too.

blocks.h2: Small Drains on Lincoln Park Lots
blocks.body: On a Lincoln Park lot, outdoor drains are small and easy to forget: a grate in the back patio, a drain at the bottom of the basement stairs or one in the gangway. Each one is the only way water leaves that spot. When it clogs with leaves or sand, water pools against the building and finds its way inside. Clearing them once a year, and after big storms, prevents a lot of wet basements.

blocks.h2: Catch Basin Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: How often should a catch basin be cleaned?
items.answer: At least once a year, usually in the fall. Basins under trees may need it more often.

items.q: Can a clogged basin flood my basement?
items.answer: Yes. Water that pools by the building can come in through walls, window wells or stairwells.

items.q: Is my back patio drain a catch basin?
items.answer: Often. Many patio and areaway drains are small catch basins with the same need for cleaning.

items.q: Can you rebuild an old brick basin?
items.answer: Often. We rebuild walls and reset grates, or replace the basin if it's too far gone.

items.q: Can you clear a stairwell drain at the basement door?
items.answer: Yes. These clog often and flood the door when they do.

items.q: How much does catch basin work cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the job. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether it's a cleaning, a repair or line work. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
